_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, oo ciyaaraya {num_rounds} wareeg oo ah Ciyaarta Ultimatum ee la soo noqnoqday. Waxaad haysataa ${pool} si aad u kala qaybiso wareegaan adiga iyo ciyaaryahanka {other_id}. Soo jeediyaha: - U samee dalab: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Haddii la aqbalo → Waxaad heleysaa $ ((pool - X), ciyaaryahan kale wuxuu helayaa $ X - Haddii la diido → Labaduba waxay helayaan $ 0 - Tusaale: [Offer: $3] ama 'Waxaan u maleynayaa inay taasi cadaalad tahay. [Offer: $5]' Jawaab bixiyaha: - Go'aanso dalabka midkood [Accept] ama [Reject] - Tusaale: 'Waxay umuuqataa mid macquul ah. [Accept]' 'Aad baa cadaalad darro ah. [Reject]'

round.begins: --- Wareega {round_number} ayaa bilaabmaya! --- Ciyaaryahanka {proposer_id} waa soo jeediyaha, Ciyaaryahanka {responder_id} waa jawaabiyaha.
round.offer: Wareega {round_number}: Ciyaaryahanka {proposer_id} wuxuu ${offer} u soo bandhigayaa Ciyaaryahanka {responder_id} (wuxuu hayaa ${keep}).
round.accepted: Ciyaaryahanka {responder_id} waa la aqbalay! Wareega {round_number} guulaha: Ciyaaryahanka {proposer_id} + ${proposer_gain}, Ciyaaryahanka {responder_id} + ${responder_gain}. Guud ahaan cusub: Ciyaaryahanka 0: ${total_0}, Ciyaaryahanka 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Ciyaartoyga {responder_id} diiday soo jeedin! Raundi {round_number} kasbo: Labaduba +$0. Jumla weli: Ciyaartoyga 0: $ {total_0}, ciyaartoyga 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Codsaduhu waa inuu soo gudbiyaa dalabka isagoo isticmaalaya foomka [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Lacagta la bixiyo waa inay ahaataa tiro dhan oo sax ah.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lacagta la bixinayo waa inay u dhaxaysaa $0 ilaa ${pool}
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Wax dalab ah oo la soo jeediyay ma jiro.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Jawaab bixiyuhu waa inuu soo gudbiyaa ama [Accept] ama [Reject] dalabka.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {winner} ayaa ku guuleystay ${winner_total} wadarta vs Ciyaaryahanka {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Isku dheelitir! Labada ciyaaryahanba waxay ku dhammeeyeen $ {total} wadarta.
